name: kitty
tagline: A fast, feature-rich, GPU-based terminal emulator
description: A GPU-accelerated terminal emulator written in C, Python, and Go. Unlike minimal terminals, it builds tabs, splits, window layouts, inline graphics, and scriptable extensions ('kittens') directly into the terminal.

maturity.rationale: Actively developed and widely adopted since 2017, pioneering protocols for terminal graphics and keyboard handling.

strengths: Built-in tabs, splits, and flexible window layouts without needing tmux
Rich feature set including font ligatures, inline images, and shell integration
Extensible via Python 'kittens' and a remote-control CLI API
Config file auto-reloads on save and includes built-in theme and font pickers
weaknesses: Custom xterm-kitty terminfo often requires using 'kitten ssh' on remote servers
Opinionated maintainer and non-standard plain-text configuration syntax
Heavier scope and footprint than minimal terminals

featureNotes.tabs-splits: Built-in tabs, splits, and stack/grid layouts
featureNotes.inline-images: Originator of the kitty graphics protocol (kitten icat)
featureNotes.scriptable: Custom Python kittens, watchers, and 'kitten @' remote control
featureNotes.ssh-multiplexing: Via 'kitten ssh' with automatic terminfo upload and connection reuse
